জনাব সালেহ আহমেদ
৩৫তম বিসিএস (সাধারণ শিক্ষা)
প্রভাষক, ইংরেজি বিভাগ।
মৌলভীবাজার সরকারি কলেজ।

English WIzard.question: ১) We were asked to wait <u>till the signal was given</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English WIzard.option1: ক) Adverb clause of time
English WIzard.option2: খ) Adverb clause of manner
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) Adverb clause of cause & effect
English WIzard.exp:
Before, wherever, while, till, until দ্বারা advervial clause of time শুরু হয়।
এছাড়াও প্রদত্ত বাক্যে ‘till the signal was given’ clause টি verb ‘wait’ কে modify করছে। তাই clause টি adverbial clause.

English WIzard.question: ২) By reading this book, you will have nice directions to make good results. (make it complex)
English WIzard.option1: ক) By reading this book, you will have nice directions so that you make good results.
English WIzard.option2: খ) If you read this book, you will have nice directions to make good results.
English WIzard.option3: গ) By reading this book, you will have nice directions in order to make good results.
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) Unless you read this book, you will have nice directions to make good results.
English WIzard.exp:
• By + gerund (verb-ing) Simple Sentence কে Complex Sentence এ transform করার নিয়ম:
(i) By এর জায়গায় if বসে।
(ii) Verb এর ing-form মূল verb এ পরিবর্তিত হয়।
(iii) Finite verb এর subject থেকে অবশিষ্ট বাক্যাংশ অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

- তাই নিয়মানুযাইয়ি সঠিক উত্তর - If you read this book, you will have nice directions to make good results.

English WIzard.question: ৩) Terminator –
English WIzard.option1: ক) illustrates the main idea of the paragraph.
English WIzard.option2: খ) presents the main idea of the paragraph.
English WIzard.option3: গ) comes at the middle of a paragraph.
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) puts an end to the paragraph.
English WIzard.exp:
Paragraph এর ৩টি অংশ রয়েছে। যথা:
1. Topic sentence
2. Body
3. Terminator.

Terminate অর্থ শেষ করা।
আর যা শেষ করার জন্য আসে তা হচ্ছে Terminator.

তাই সঠিক উত্তর হচ্ছে puts an end to the paragraph.

English WIzard.question: ৪) “All at once” means
English WIzard.option1: ক) suddenly
English WIzard.option2: খ) gradually
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) loosely
English WIzard.exp: All at once = হঠাৎ করে = suddenly.

English WIzard.question: ৫) ‘Add insult to injury’ means-
English WIzard.option1: ক) to rebuke someone
English WIzard.option2: খ) to hurt someone
English WIzard.option3: গ) to worsen an unfavorable situation
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) to help miscreants
English WIzard.exp: Add insult to injury = to worsen an unfavorable situation = প্রতিকূল পরিস্থিতিকে আরো খারাপ করে দেওয়া, বোঝার উপর শাঁকের আঁটি।

English WIzard.question: ৬) Which sentence includes an adverb clause of purpose?
English WIzard.option1: ক) The more you read, the more you learn.
English WIzard.option2: খ) Wherever you go, I will find you out.
English WIzard.option3: গ) He works hard so that he can prosper in life.
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) I can work better than he does.
English WIzard.exp:
• He works hard so that he can prosper in life. - Adverb clause of purpose.
• The more you read, the more you learn. - Adverb Clause of Comparison.
• I can work better than he does. - Adverb Clause of Comparison.
• Wherever you go, I will find you out. - Adverb Clause of Place

English WIzard.question: ৭) They bought a new machine to increase productivity. (make it compound)
English WIzard.option1: ক) They bought a new machine in order that they could increase productivity.
English WIzard.option2: খ) They bought a new machine so that the machine can increase productivity.
English WIzard.option3: গ) They bought a new machine and they can increase productivity.
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) They wanted to increase productivity and so they bought a new machine.
English WIzard.exp:
• Simple sentence এ to অথবা in order to থাকলে Compound sentence এ and so/and so/ and therefore বসাতে হয়।
- এক্ষেত্রে Clause গুলো উল্টে যাবে এবং প্রথম Clause এ ‘want to’ যোগ হবে।
- সে অনুসারে প্রদত্ত বাক্যের সঠিক compound form হবে - They wanted to increase productivity and so they bought a new machine.

English WIzard.question: ৮) Besides being a hard-working day-labourer, he is a student of Dhaka University. (Make it Compound)
English WIzard.option1: ক) Not only he is a hard-working day-labourer but also a student of Dhaka University.
English WIzard.option2: খ) He is not only a hard-working day-labourer but also a student of Dhaka University.
English WIzard.option3: গ) He is a hard-working day-labourer but he is a student of Dhaka University.
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) He is a hard-working day-labourer and not only that he is a student of Dhaka University.
English WIzard.exp:
• Simple sentence এ “besides being” থাকলে compound sentence এ “not only..….but also” structure ব্যবহার করে compound sentence টি গঠন করতে হয়।
- সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে - He is not only a hard-working day-labourer but also a student of Dhaka University.

English WIzard.question: ৯) Trying unitedly we were able to have our project approved against strong oppositions. – Which of the following says nearly the same as 'against' above?
English WIzard.option1: ক) in the wake of
English WIzard.option2: খ) in the guise of
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) in the teeth of
English WIzard.exp: According to the Oxford Dictionary, in the teeth of means directly against.

English WIzard.question: ১০) <u>Though he is poor</u>, he is honest. What kind of adverbial clause is the underlined one?
English WIzard.option1: ক) Adverb Clause of Condition
English WIzard.option2: খ) Adverb Clause of Cause or Reason
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) Adverb Clause of Comparison
English WIzard.exp:
Verb সংঘটিত হওয়ার বিপরীতধর্মী কোন কিছু হওয়া বা করা বুঝালে adverb clause of Supposition/ Concession/ Contrast হয়।
এখানে যেহেতু বৈপরিত্য প্রকাশ করছে তাই এটি Adverb Clause of Contrast হবে।

English WIzard.question: ১১) What is the meaning of 'Soft Soap'?
English WIzard.option1: ক) To speak ill of others
English WIzard.option2: খ) To speak high of others
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) To recognise other's good deeds
English WIzard.exp:
Soft-soap (verb)
- to try to persuade someone to do what you want by saying pleasant things to them.  

Source: dictionary.cambridge.org

English WIzard.question: ১২) In spite of having all the facilities, he was not satisfied with the job. (make it compound)
English WIzard.option1: ক) He has all the facilities and he was not satisfied with the job.
English WIzard.option2: খ) He had all the facilities but he was not satisfied with the job.
English WIzard.option3: গ) He had all the facilities or he was not satisfied with the job.
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) He did not have all the facilities and he was not satisfied with the job.
English WIzard.exp:
• Despite/ in spite of/ notwithstanding যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Compound করতে হলে --
1) Despite/ in spite of/ notwithstanding যুক্ত Phrase টাকে Clause বানিয়ে বাক্যের শুরুতে বসাতে হবে।
- এ Clause টা বসানোর সময় অন্য Clause টার Tense কে অনুসরণ করতে হবে।
- অন্য Clause টা Past Tense হলে এটাও Past Tense হবে। 
2) এরপর Conjunction- but বসবে। 
3) অন্য Clause টা বসবে।
- নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর হবে - He had all the facilities but he was not satisfied with the job.

English WIzard.question: ১৩) ‘Be glad to see the back of’ means-
English WIzard.option1: ক) Be happy to arrive somewhere
English WIzard.option2: খ) Be happy when a person leaves
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) Die peacefully
English WIzard.exp: • Be glad to see the back of = কেউ চলে যাওয়াতে খুশি হওয়া = Be happy when a person leaves.

English WIzard.question: ১৪) I will go <u>where he lives</u>. This is a/an -
English WIzard.option1: ক) Adverb clause of manner
English WIzard.option2: খ) Adverb clause of purpose
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) None of these
English WIzard.exp: 'where he lives' অংশটি দ্বারা go - verb সংঘটিত হওয়ার স্থান বুঝাচ্ছে। তাই এটি Adverb clause of place.

English WIzard.question: ১৫) An extra message added at the end of a letter after it is signed is called ___ .
English WIzard.option1: ক) Corrigendum
English WIzard.option2: খ) NB
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) RSVP
English WIzard.exp:
Postscript (n) (সংক্ষেপে PS): চিঠিতে স্বাক্ষরের পরে যুক্ত বাক্যাবলী; পুনশ্চ; অতিরিক্ত বা সর্বশেষ তথ্য।

Source: Bangla Academy Dictionary- English to Bangla

English WIzard.question: ১৬) <u>Were I a rich</u>, I would help him. The underlined clause is an -
English WIzard.option1: ক) Adverb clause of consequence
English WIzard.option2: খ) Adverb clause of manner
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) Adverb clause of condition
English WIzard.exp: 'Were I a rich man' এই অংশ দ্বারা verb সংঘটিত হওয়ার শর্ত বুঝাচ্ছে, তাই এটি adverb clause of condition.

English WIzard.question: ১৭) He came here at twenty. (make it complex)
English WIzard.option1: ক) He came here so that he can earn twenty.
English WIzard.option2: খ) He came here when he was twenty.
English WIzard.option3: গ) He came here while he is twenty years old
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) He came here because he was twenty.
English WIzard.exp:
• simple sentence টি দ্বারা সময় নির্দেশ করলে when যুক্ত করে complex করতে হবে।
এখানে at twenty দ্বারা বুঝাচ্ছে ২০ বছর বয়সে।

- তাই সঠিক উত্তর - He came here when he was twenty.

English WIzard.question: ১৮) If a man is, 'worth his salt', he is –
English WIzard.option1: ক) a highly paid worker
English WIzard.option2: খ) a soldier
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) a valuable employee
English WIzard.exp:
Oxford Dictionary অনুসারে,
'Worth one's salt' = Good or competent at the job or profession specified.
সুতরাং, এখানে ঘ) a valuable employee বেশি যুক্তিযুক্ত।

English WIzard.question: ১৯) Which one is not considered a part of a formal letter?
English WIzard.option1: ক) Subject
English WIzard.option2: খ) Salutation
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) Signature of the Writer
English WIzard.exp:
Formal Letter : একটি Formal/ Official Letter/ Application এর ৬টি অংশ থাকে।

1. Heading: Date, Designation (পদবী) & Address of the Recipient
2. Salutation (সম্বোধন) : যেমন- Dear Sir/ Madam
3. Body (মূল বক্তব্য)
4. The Subscription: যেমন- Yours faithfully/ I remain, Sir
5. Signature of the Writer
6. Superscription: Detailed Designation & Address on the Envelope.

Application এর ক্ষেত্রে subject লিখতে হয়, কিন্তু এটাকে Letter এর part হিসেবে বিবেচনা করা হয় না।

English WIzard.question: ২০) Forgiveness is divine. (make it complex)
English WIzard.option1: ক) It is forgiveness which is divine.
English WIzard.option2: খ) It is divine, which is forgiveness.
English WIzard.option3: গ) You should forgive others divinely.
English WIzard.option4: ঘ) Forgiveness is a quality and it is divine.
English WIzard.exp:
অর্থ ও গঠন অনুসারে সঠিক উত্তর ক)

খ) অপশনে it is 'divine' ব্যবহার করার কারণে বাক্যের অর্থ পরিবর্তন হয়ে যাচ্ছে তাই এটি ভুল।
গ) অপশন সম্পূর্ণ ভিন্ন অর্থ প্রকাশ করছে তাই এটিও ভুল।
ঘ) অপশনে compound sentence এর structure অনুসৃত হয়েছে বিধায় এটিও সঠিক নয়।
